claim: A D18/PY-IT/eC9 arm cannot support a durable-useful-work claim from initial stabilized Pmax alone; paired normalized retention and absolute Pmax must be followed under a prospectively frozen stress protocol, and a physical noninferiority margin must be frozen before unblinding.

source_provenance.citation: Reese et al., Consensus stability testing protocols for organic photovoltaic materials and devices, Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells 95 (2011) 1253-1267
source_provenance.role: OPV stability-test and reporting precedent; not D18/PY-IT/eC9 lifetime evidence

decision_contract.kill_narrow_rule: If the arm has favorable initial Pmax but loses the paired absolute-Pmax advantage under the frozen stress endpoint, do not call it durable useful-work validation.

equations.retention_penalty: D(t)=R_B0(t)-R_arm(t); positive means worse normalized retention for the arm

uncertainty_requirements.real_data: Record uncertainty and shared/systematic components for Pmax, irradiance, temperature, active area, tracking and elapsed time. Do not infer field lifetime from accelerated stress without a validated acceleration model.
uncertainty_requirements.margin_rule: No physical durability margin may be derived from the synthetic fixture. Freeze it from B0 baseline repeatability, instrument capability, literature precedent where applicable, and prospective power analysis.

falsifiers: A favorable initial Pmax arm crosses below paired B0 absolute Pmax during the prospectively frozen stress endpoint.
A nominal durability advantage disappears after temperature/irradiance/contact/encapsulation or morphology controls.
The decision changes under the predeclared uncertainty or lot-level sensitivity analysis.
